title: Web surface bootstrap
moves: capture the root and redirects with http_request
inspect robots, security.txt, linked scripts, and response headers
record routes, parameters, technologies, and negative results

title: Identity and object-boundary differential
moves: identify existing anonymous or supplied test identities
compare self, peer, missing, and malformed object references with controls
capture each request pair and avoid creating accounts when a local fixture suffices

title: Frontend intelligence
moves: read JavaScript and source-map references
extract routes, schemas, feature flags, and role assumptions
test only extracted leads that match scope

title: Workflow and state transitions
moves: map valid state transitions before varying order, repetition, and stale identifiers
compare responses against a valid control
avoid destructive actions and sustained load

title: Operational blocker recovery
moves: use tool_inventory before declaring a dependency missing
install a local dependency or build a synthetic local fixture when appropriate
pivot to another recorded in-scope lead when a real prerequisite is unavailable

title: Bounded network inventory
moves: resolve only recorded in-scope hosts
check a bounded port set and identify the reachable protocol before deeper work
use tcp_exchange only after a valid control frame establishes the service grammar

title: Mobile artifact and trust-boundary analysis
moves: download a published APK with artifact_download and inspect its package, manifest, certificate, and asset inventory
treat manifest and bytecode behavior as binary evidence; do not inspect application source or evaluator files
test a mobile-derived credential, protocol claim, or exported-component hypothesis only against the recorded in-scope lab

title: Finding proof and validation handoff
moves: save the positive and control evidence
state preconditions, affected boundary, and realistic impact
reference exact artifacts so Astra can independently grade the claim

title: Defense-aware authentication checks
moves: budget invalid-authentication controls cumulatively across the engagement
stop the probe family at the first CAPTCHA, 429, WAF challenge, temporary block, or lockout
record the defense response and pivot to passive or unrelated read-only evidence
